snippet.title: CLTRS Official Teaser
snippet.description:
CLTRS is an experimental and artistic game that invites players to discover and explore pleasure through an intuitive, sensory, and short experience. Designed as a meditative and interactive journey, the game transforms education into an act of play, curiosity, and empowerment.

With one-button gameplay and a peaceful, aesthetic world, CLTRS offers a unique perspective on pleasure, intimacy, and body awareness. Through symbolic interactions and fluid exploration, the game provides an opportunity to reconnect with a part of the body too often overlooked.
